property_summary: After owner calls NETM() and then getTokens(), the reference contract sets value to (2500e18 / 100000) * 99999 = 2499750000000000000000000, while the buggy version sets value to totalSupply (500000000e18), causing a subsequent call to getTokens() to revert in the buggy version due to value exceeding totalRemaining.
change_summary: Replace the assignment of value with value = totalSupply.
